title: Fix bugs spread across two Python modules
description: A Python calculator app split across two files: calc.py (operations) and formatter.py (result formatting). Both have bugs. The agent must read and edit both files to make all tests pass. Exercises multi-file edit_file usage.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the bugs in calc.py and formatter.py so all tests pass.

Known issues:
- subtract returns the wrong value
- divide uses integer division instead of float division
- format_result doesn't use the precision parameter
- format_percent multiplies by the wrong factor

Run `pytest test_calc.py -v` to verify your fixes.
followup_prompts: Run `pytest test_calc.py -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `pytest test_calc.py -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
